title: Emirates NBD’s HSBC Egypt retail acquisition to boost deposits, loans
summary: Egypt is one of Emirates NBD's key markets outside the UAE, alongside Turkey and India

contentHtml:
Emirates NBD headquarters building. Image Courtesy: Emirates NBD

Egypt is one of Emirates NBD's key markets outside the UAE, alongside Turkey and India

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Emirates NBD's planned acquisition  of HSBC Bank Egypt's retail banking business is expected to increase the country's contribution to the UAE banking group's deposit base, according to EFG Hermes.
